letter.role_title: Intern AI and Machine Learning at Rolls-Royce Motor Cars (f/m/x)
letter.greeting: Dear Rolls-Royce Motor Cars Analytics & AI team,
letter.opening: I am applying for the internship in AI and Machine Learning. Designing, training and evaluating models end to end, and explaining the results clearly to business teams, is the combination I have worked on in my projects and in analytics roles.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. Before my Master's I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP analytics consulting.

achievements.impact: I fine-tuned a pretrained EfficientNet-B0 in PyTorch to 94.11% accuracy on a 968-image test set
I built a RAG application with the Claude API, evaluated on a 22-question test set: 91% correct, all 4 unanswerable questions refused, and hybrid retrieval raised MRR from 0.748 to 0.898
I translated business requirements into KPI dashboards and presented to a client, who subsequently purchased SAP Analytics Cloud

letter.problems_section: I would help explore data, prototype and evaluate models including agentic AI use cases, and visualise findings for Sales, Aftersales and Brand. I have not built agents or deployed models to production yet, and I would learn both from your team.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Munich and can start immediately. As a non-EU student I will agree the internship length and hours with you so they fit my permitted working days. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
